name: Ninja Shadow-Warrior
body:
Some ninjas don’t simply skulk through shadows, they become them by embracing their potential as denizens of the dark.

Shadow Sneak (Ex)

A shadow-warrior can make sneak attacks against creatures benefiting from concealment, including total concealment, if the target and the shadow-warrior both have concealment from the same source, such as both being in a dark room.

This ability alters sneak attack.

Shadow-strider (Ex)

Shadow-warriors gain a bonus to Acrobatics and Climb checks equal to 1/2 their class level.

This ability replaces poison use.

Shadowed Footsteps (Su)

Beginning at 2nd level, a shadow-warrior can make an Acrobatics check to pass through a space occupied by another creature as long as there is an area of shadow adjacent to that creature (whether its own shadow or one cast by a nearby object or creature). The DC for this check is the creature’s CMD. On a success, the shadow-warrior gains 20% concealment against any attack of opportunity incurred as they are briefly wrapped in shadow.

This ability replaces no trace and its improvements.

Shadow Dance (Su)

Beginning at 4th level, a shadowwarrior can travel between shadows as easily as doorways. As a standard action, the shadow-warrior may teleport from one touched shadow (at least half the size of the shadow-warrior) to another shadow within 30 feet plus an additional 5 feet for every two class levels.

This ability replaces uncanny dodge.

Shadow Stabbing (Ex)

Beginning at 8th level, whenever a shadow-warrior appears adjacent to a creature when using their shadow dance ability, they may make a melee attack against that creature as a swift action. If that attack hits it is considered to meet the requirements for a sneak attack.

This ability replaces improved uncanny dodge.
